{{Quote|It's a brutal world.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref>}}
'''Bandomeer''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]]. It was known for its high concentration of [[ionite]], as well as the many predators lurking in its wildernesses. The planet's surface was roughly divided in half by a huge landmass and the [[Great Sea of Bandomeer]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The planet-wide farms provide a ''crucial'' service for the Republic... Without us, clone troopers across the galaxy would ''starve'' from lack of rations.|[[Unidentified Bandomeer commander|A commander]]|<ref name="Dead Shadows">{{TCWComicCite|6.39|Dead Shadows}}</ref>}}
[[File:Meerian-UAA.png|thumb|left|120px|A [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]].]]
The planet was at one time an agricultural world of rolling plains until it was discovered that many valuable ores were hidden in its crust. Then, mining operations such as [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] took control, and reduced it to strip mines and industrial wastes. The planet was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] race, who struggled to come to terms with the prosperity that cost their world's natural beauty. Even Bandomeer's surrounding [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] were rich with mineral deposits, but could not be mined due to the risk of fragments colliding with the planet.

==History==
{{Quote|I was originally posted here as part of the ''Jedi AgriCorps''...|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Dead Shadows" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]], [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-[[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] on Bandomeer discovered the wreckage of an ancient and undocumented [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Priceless Debris}}</ref>

Bandomeer was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world dominated by the Offworld Mining Corporation until [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. When [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] [[Mission to Bandomeer|arrived]] on the world, they narrowly saved it from destruction at the hands of [[Xanatos]].

[[File:BattleofBandomeer.jpg|left|thumb|[[Battle of Bandomeer]].]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the Ionite miners of Bandomeer refused to honor their contracts with the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In order to teach them to treat the new government with respect, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered his apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to deal with the local resistance. The [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] quickly [[Battle of Bandomeer|overwhelmed]] the lightly armed miners and established control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

[[Huff Darklighter]] once employed farmers from Bandomeer, as well as [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]] and [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]], to staff his underground hydroponic gardens on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The planet was the site of a [[Battle of Bandomeer (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] shortly before [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TEA" />

Bandomeer was [[Attack on the Bandomeer system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The world was used by the invaders as a launch point for the [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack on]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
